title: CLAUDE.md
text: package implements multi-step pipeline (see vignettes/CellTFusion.Rmd authoritative step/function/tutorial mapping): Normalization — log-TPM normalization raw counts (ADImpute::NormalizeTPM) Cell-type deconvolution — multiple algorithms via multideconv::compute.deconvolution() (Quantiseq, Epidish, DeconRNASeq, DWLS, CIBERSORTx) TF activity inference — compute.TFs.activity(): CollecTRI/Dorothea/ARACNe regulons scored via decoupleR (method = "ulm" default; "mlm", "wsum", "consensus") TF module construction — compute.WTCNA(): WGCNA-based weighted co-expression networks Pathway scoring — compute.pathway.activity(): PROGENy-based pathway activities via decoupleR (method = "ulm" default) Cell group construction — construct_cell_groups(): TF module–deconvolution correlation, dendrogram cutting CCA composite scores Latent factor extraction — compute.latent_factors(): NMF-based latent factors; compute_cells_niches() cell niche derivation Statistical analysis — clinical trait association (scores.stat.analysis() scores.* family), survival analysis (compute.survival.analysis()) Test-set / batch projection — apply trained model new data (compute.test.set() cell group scores; project_factors() project scores onto trained NMF factors), run leakage-aware cross-validation pipeML (prepare_celltfusion_folds()), run multi-cohort analysis via batch (cohort sample) CellTFusion()
